page.layout: One page of text with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Text in one column, with a short centred list of three lines in the middle.

main_text.l: Respectiva sunt totidem, absolutis ex asse

l.i: Horum principiorum definitiones tenenda sunt, ut
per definitiones ipsa cognoscantur, & ut ipsis homo u-
tatur affirmando & negando, ita ut definitiones ma-
neant illasa. Definitiones ista sunt nominales. Reales
enim principiorum definitiones dari non possunt.

main_text.l: Bonitas est id, cujus ratione ens producit
Magnitudo est id, cujus ratione bonitas &
Duratio est, ratione cujus bonitas, magni-
Potestas est, ratione cujus reliqua principia
Sapientia est, ratione cujus sapiens intelligit
Voluntas est ratione cujus reliqua principia
Virtus est origo unionis bonitatis, magni-
Veritas est illud, quod est verum de bonita-
Gloria est ipsa delectatio, in quâ bonitas,
Differentia est id, ratione cujus bonitas, &
reliqua principia sunt inconfusa atq; clara.

page.notes: The "&" mark at the top right, above the margin, is a stray printed sign and is not transcribed. The note "Respectiva." is taken from the margin beside the first line. The hyphenated word at "resi-" (line end) is read as "resi-" and is slightly doubtful, since the scan shows "refi-" or "resi-". The paragraph "Potestas est, ratione cujus reliqua principia" appears to end after one line and may be incomplete in the print. The margin note on the Gloria line is set in italic and is kept as printed.
